about: Who the opening and the Politics screen call key people (owner ruling, Oct 15, 2026, afternoon, OWNER-DECISIONS.md): the president and vice president; the state's legislators; the most powerful person in each chamber (the one chamber where a state has only one); and the player's own representatives (their council member, state legislators, U.S. representative and senators). Nothing else is key at the opening. The most powerful person in a chamber is the holder of the post its rules give the power to assign members to committees and choose their chairs.
mostPowerfulBasis: data/research/legislature/chamber-leadership.json assignmentAuthority and chairSelectionAuthority: the House and the unicameral chamber's committee on committees and the state House's speaker act through the Speaker; the Senate's party caucuses act through the majority leader; a state senate's own president (its president pro tempore, where the lieutenant governor only presides) assigns and chooses.
